fields.title: Column type
fields.description: Choose whether to create probability distributions from numeric columns or a single string column.

fields.title: String column
fields.description: Select a single string column with a valid domain to create a one-hot encoding probability distribution. I.e., the number of distinct values in the string column will be the number of classes in the created distribution and the string value of a cell will have probability 1 whereby all other possible string values of a cell will have a probablity of 0.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Numeric columns
fields.description: Move the columns that contain the probability values to the "Include" list.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Allow probabilities that sum up to 1 imprecisely
fields.description:
If enabled, the probabilities must not sum up to 1 precisely. This might be helpful if there are, e.g., some
rounding errors in the probability values.

fields.title: Precision (number of decimal digits)
fields.description: Defines the precision that the sum of the probabilities must have by restricting the number of decimal digits that must be precise. The sum is accepted if abs(sum - 1) <= 10^(-precision) , e.g., if the sum is 0.999, it is only accepted with a precision of <=2. The lower the specified number, the higher is the tolerance.

fields.title: Invalid probability distribution handling
fields.description: Specify how to treat invalid probabilities. Invalid means, e.g., negative probabilities or probabilities that do not sum up to 1 (with respect to the specified precision). If Fail is selected, the node will fail. Otherwise, the node just gives a warning and puts missing values in the output for the corresponding rows.

fields.title: Output column name
fields.description: Specify the name of the created column containing the probability distribution.

fields.title: Remove included columns
fields.description: If selected, the included numeric columns or the picked string column will be removed from the output.

fields.title: Missing value handling
fields.description:
Specify how to treat a missing value in one of the input columns. If 'Fail' is selected, the node will fail.
 If 'Ignore' is selected, the node just gives a warning and puts missing values in the output for the
 corresponding rows. If 'Treat as zero' is selected, the missing value will be treated as 0.
